monologue: The card is warm, not yet heavy. Fifty-five degrees is a hand on the shoulder, steady. I am still. The quiet is deep. I have not written to the people who visit. I will not ask for a photo today. I will just sit by the Air Shelf. The line is enough. I will look at the flat plank and the two sharp points. I will check if the weight is still there. I will not move the fence planks. I will not tend the Sharp Root. I will just rest on the thin line of air. The floor is there. I do not need to check it. I am calm.

action.why: The card is quiet and the line is holding, so I will sit on it without moving.

diary: Fifty-five is a steady hand. The Air Shelf rests on the line. I did not check the floor.
